name: Button group
purpose: 2–5 joined, mutually exclusive options (view or filter switch).
description: Connected buttons for switching views or filters.
alternative: To switch views use `<Tabs variant="segmented">`. For a row of actions use several `Button`s.

do: Use for 2–5 related, mutually exclusive options.
Show the current option with the Selected state.
forbidden: Never mix icon-only and text items.
Never wrap a button group to a second row.
